cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The club's changing the menu. Keep that quiet before I tell you the bigger news.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Not even the person you tell everything to?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We've found the first lock to check.

mechanism: A tests a helper with progressively more sensitive club-kitchen information while correcting proposed routes of disclosure.
confusable: Simply hiding a secret misses the progressive trust test; each new detail should follow or test B's response.
comparison: A club-ordering colleague is tested through operational discretion; the other alternative tests a sibling with a family-linked business decision.
seedUse: Use menu change as the first low-stakes detail, then add chef departure and A's kitchen takeover.
